const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboLab eai-standard/2.2 butter-on-raisins episode controller.
+
+The box centres below were estimated by back-projecting the visible top faces
+from the calibrated shoulder camera depth image into the robot base frame.
+Each phase is callable separately so observations can be checked between
+contact, lift, transport, and release.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import EpisodeOver, Robot
+
+
+# Estimated centres of the visible top-face footprints, env-local metres.
+BUTTER_XY = np.array([0.3725, 0.0522], dtype=float)
+RAISIN_XY = np.array([0.4037, 0.1971], dtype=float)
+# Preserve the reset's downward-facing TCP orientation. Its finger closing
+# axis is approximately across the boxes' short dimension.
+DOWN = np.array([0.0, -0.70710678, 0.70710678, 0.0], dtype=float)
+TABLE_Z = 0.0037
+BUTTER_TOP_Z = 0.0274
+RAISIN_TOP_Z = 0.0415
+GRASP_TCP_Z = 0.009
+PLACE_TCP_Z = RAISIN_TOP_Z + (GRASP_TCP_Z - TABLE_Z)
+
+
+def connect():
+    r = Robot()
+    status = r.status()
+    print("status", json.dumps(status))
+    if status.get("done"):
+        print("episode already ended:", status.get("reason"))
+        raise SystemExit(0)
+    return r
+
+
+def obs_and_save(r, name):
+    o = r.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+    folder = "/app/output/observations"
+    os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, image in o.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(image).save(os.path.join(folder, f"{name}_{cam}.jpg"), quality=92)
+    for cam, depth in o.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(os.path.join(folder, f"{name}_{cam}_depth.npy"), depth)
+    print("tcp", np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15]).round(5).tolist(),
+          "gripper_opening_m", round(float(o.meta["proprio"]["now"][24]), 5),
+          "gripper_cmd", float(o.meta["proprio"]["now"][15]))
+    return o
+
+
+def pose_from_obs(o):
+    now = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    return now[8:15].copy()
+
+
+def move(r, xyz, grip, name, step_m=0.010, repeats=0):
+    """Send short, straight TCP increments (<= 1 cm per control row)."""
+    o = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    start = pose_from_obs(o)
+    target = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), DOWN]
+    d = float(np.linalg.norm(target[:3] - start[:3]))
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(d / step_m)))
+    rows = []
+    for i in range(1, n + 1):
+        f = i / n
+        rows.append(np.r_[start[:3] + f * (target[:3] - start[:3]), DOWN, float(grip)])
+    rows.extend([np.r_[target[:3], DOWN, float(grip)] for _ in range(repeats)])
+    result = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), video="none",
+                      note=f"butter_above_raisin:{name}")
+    print(name, "rows", len(rows), "distance_m", round(d, 4),
+          "executed", result.meta.get("executed_rows"),
+          "done", result.meta.get("done"), "reason", result.meta.get("reason"),
+          "plan", result.meta.get("plan"))
+    if result.done:
+        return result
+    obs_and_save(r, name)
+    print("status", json.dumps(r.status()))
+    return result
+
+
+def run(phase):
+    r = connect()
+    if phase == "prep":
+        # Come above the butter with the fingers open, then pause for inspection.
+        return move(r, [BUTTER_XY[0], BUTTER_XY[1], 0.145], 0, "hover_butter")
+    if phase == "grasp":
+        move(r, [BUTTER_XY[0], BUTTER_XY[1], GRASP_TCP_Z], 0, "descend_butter")
+        if r.status().get("done"):
+            return
+        return move(r, [BUTTER_XY[0], BUTTER_XY[1], GRASP_TCP_Z], 1, "close_on_butter", repeats=9)
+    if phase == "lift":
+        return move(r, [BUTTER_XY[0], BUTTER_XY[1], 0.155], 1, "lift_butter")
+    if phase == "transfer":
+        return move(r, [RAISIN_XY[0], RAISIN_XY[1], 0.155], 1, "carry_over_raisins")
+    if phase == "place":
+        move(r, [RAISIN_XY[0], RAISIN_XY[1], PLACE_TCP_Z], 1, "lower_to_raisins")
+        if r.status().get("done"):
+            return
+        return move(r, [RAISIN_XY[0], RAISIN_XY[1], PLACE_TCP_Z], 0, "release_on_raisins", repeats=8)
+    if phase == "retreat":
+        return move(r, [RAISIN_XY[0], RAISIN_XY[1], 0.17], 0, "retreat_after_release")
+    if phase == "observe":
+        obs_and_save(r, "manual_check")
+        return
+    raise ValueError(phase)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=["prep", "grasp", "lift", "transfer", "place", "retreat", "observe"])
+    run(parser.parse_args().phase)
*** End Patch";
